die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Name: One insurance policy for every situation in life?
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Headline: Universal solution or myth? Why individual insurance is indispensable.
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Einleitungstext: Insurance is like tailor-made clothing for your financial security. Yet one myth stubbornly persists: the idea of a kind of "one-size-fits-all insurance" that is supposed to be enough for every situation in life. Let's take a closer look and clear up this misunderstanding.
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Mythos Titel: One policy fits all – why go tailor-made?
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Mythos Beschreibung: The myth of one-size-fits-all insurance is based on the idea that a general policy covers every eventuality. But life isn't standardised. Everyone has individual needs that vary depending on their life situation, job, marital status and financial circumstances.
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Aufklärung / Realität Titel: The reality: a wide range of insurance needs
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Realität Beschreibung: Let's say you're just starting out in your career. You need professional liability insurance to protect you against work-related risks. At this stage, however, a pension insurance policy is less relevant than occupational disability insurance. If you later start a family, children's insurance and adequate life insurance suddenly come into focus.
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Beispiel Beschreibung 1: Thomas is starting out as a software developer. He needs professional liability insurance to protect himself against work-related risks. An expensive endowment life insurance policy, on the other hand, would make less sense, as he doesn't have a family at this stage.
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Beispiel Beschreibung 2: Lisa and Tim have just got married and are expecting their first child. Now term life insurance is important to protect the partner and the child financially. Private supplementary health insurance can improve the family's healthcare.
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Beispiel Beschreibung 3: Anita's children have left home and she is retiring. What she needs now is private long-term care insurance and suitable retirement provision to maintain her standard of living.
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Fazit Titel: Conclusion: individual insurance solutions are essential
die-einheitsversicherung-fur-alle-lebens.Fazit Beschreibung: The idea of one-size-fits-all insurance may sound tempting, but it ignores the variety of individual needs. Tailor-made insurance gives you exactly the protection you need in your current stage of life. An experienced insurance expert can work with you to choose the right policies, making sure you're optimally covered – without paying for insurance you don't need. Don't settle for a one-size-fits-all policy; choose tailor-made cover that fits your life. After all, just as a suit or a dress is individually fitted, your insurance should also be tailored to your personal needs.

die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Name: The truth about no-claims classes (Schadenfreiheitsklassen)
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Headline: Clarity on no-claims classes: how they affect your car insurance.
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Einleitungstext: No-claims classes (Schadenfreiheitsklassen) are a frequently misunderstood concept in car insurance. Many people think they mean you've never had a single accident. The truth, however, is more complex. No-claims classes are a system for rating your insurance history. The longer you drive without a claim, the higher you climb through the classes. A small claim doesn't necessarily mean losing your current class. It's important to know how claims affect your class and how the system actually works.
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Mythos Titel: Myth: no-claims classes mean no accidents – is that true?
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Mythos Beschreibung: The assumption that no-claims classes mean you've never been involved in an accident isn't correct. Rather, no-claims classes reflect your insurance history. Even after a small accident, you won't necessarily lose your entire class and automatically pay more. It's important to understand the exact consequences.
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Aufklärung / Realität Titel: The reality: no-claims classes as a rating system
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Realität Beschreibung: Let's say you cause a minor parking dent. This doesn't necessarily mean you'll now slide down to the lowest class. There are often rules under which smaller claims aren't treated as serious blemishes on your insurance history. This can mean you stay in the same class and your premium doesn't rise significantly.
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Beispiel Beschreibung 1: You're parking and accidentally bump lightly into the car behind you. The repair costs are low, but you wonder whether this will affect your no-claims class. In most cases, it won't have a significant impact.
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Beispiel Beschreibung 2: You collide with an animal on the road and your car is damaged. Since this is an unavoidable accident, it is generally not counted as a blemish on your insurance history.
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Beispiel Beschreibung 3: You cause an accident that damages several cars. In this case your no-claims class could change, but it won't automatically drop back to the lowest level.
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Fazit Titel: Conclusion: understand no-claims classes and assess them realistically
die-wahrheit-uber-schadensfreiheitsklass.Fazit Beschreibung: The truth about no-claims classes is less intimidating than the myth suggests. It's important to know how they work so that you aren't caught out by misunderstandings. A small accident doesn't necessarily mean losing your current class. Talk to an experienced insurance expert to get a clear picture of how claims could affect your no-claims class and what impact this could have on your premium.

versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Name: Is legal expenses insurance unnecessary?
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Headline: Why legal expenses insurance isn't unnecessary and how it protects you.
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Einleitungstext: A common myth is that legal expenses insurance is unnecessary because it's hardly ever needed. But the reality is different. Legal disputes can quickly become expensive, whether it's a dispute over a purchase contract or a disagreement with your landlord. Legal expenses insurance can spare you the financial stress that comes with such situations. It can provide you with legal support and cover the costs of lawyers and court proceedings.
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Mythos Titel: Legal expenses insurance is unnecessary – why would I need it?
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Mythos Beschreibung: It's tempting to think that legal problems rarely occur and that legal expenses insurance is therefore unnecessary. But accidents, contractual disputes or trouble with your landlord can arise suddenly and confront you with major financial challenges. Legal expenses insurance helps you enforce your rights without worry.
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Aufklärung / Realität Titel: The reality: financial protection in legal disputes
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Realität Beschreibung: Imagine you're involved in a car accident that isn't your fault. However, the other party refuses to accept responsibility. Without legal expenses insurance, the costs of lawyers and court proceedings could place a considerable burden on you. With legal expenses insurance, you have the support you need to defend your interests without running into financial difficulties.
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Beispiel Beschreibung 1: As a tenant, you end up in a dispute with your landlord over repair costs. Legal expenses insurance can help you enforce your claims without having to pay the lawyer's fees yourself.
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Beispiel Beschreibung 2: You're involved in a road accident in which the person who caused it denies being at fault. Legal expenses insurance covers the costs of having the question of fault settled in court
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Beispiel Beschreibung 3: As a self-employed person, you have problems with a client who doesn't want to pay an invoice. Legal expenses insurance supports you in recovering outstanding payments.
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Fazit Titel: Conclusion: legal expenses insurance as financial protection
versicherungsmythen-entlarven-die-uberfl.Fazit Beschreibung: The notion that legal expenses insurance is unnecessary can turn out to be a costly mistake. Legal disputes can arise unexpectedly and lead to high costs. Legal expenses insurance gives you financial protection and legal support when you need it most. Get advice from experienced insurance experts to find the right legal expenses insurance for your needs.

welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Name: Which insurance do I need as a freelancer?
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Headline: Tailor-made cover for freelancers: find out which insurance policies protect your self-employment.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Einleitungstext: As a freelancer, you're self-employed and responsible for your own business. Along the way, various risks can arise that could threaten your livelihood. To protect yourself against the financial consequences and run your business successfully, it's important to take out the right insurance. Here is a checklist of the recommended insurance policies for freelancers:
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Beschreibung Versicherung 1: Professional liability insurance protects you against compensation claims by third parties that could arise from your professional work. It's particularly important if you could be held liable for mistakes or damage.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Beschreibung Versicherung 2: Business liability insurance protects you against claims that could arise in the course of running your business, e.g. through client visits or production processes.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Beschreibung Versicherung 3: As a freelancer, you depend on your ability to work. Occupational disability insurance gives you financial protection if you can no longer pursue your profession due to illness or an accident.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Beschreibung Versicherung 4: As a freelancer, you need health insurance to receive medical care. Depending on your income, you can choose between statutory and private health insurance.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Beschreibung Versicherung 5: Legal expenses insurance covers the costs of legal disputes and provides you with legal support if disagreements or conflicts arise.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Beschreibung Versicherung 6: Contents insurance protects your business equipment, such as office furniture, tools or computers, against damage caused by e.g. burglary, fire or water damage.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Beschreibung Versicherung 7: Cyber insurance provides protection against the financial consequences of cyber attacks, data protection breaches or data loss that can affect your business.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Beschreibung Versicherung 8: Business contents insurance protects your goods or stock against damage caused by theft, fire or other risks.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Beschreibung Versicherung 9: Plan ahead early for your financial future and take out a private pension insurance policy or another form of retirement provision so that you're well covered in retirement.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.Beschreibung Versicherung 10: Business interruption insurance protects you against loss of income if your business temporarily comes to a standstill due to an insured loss.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-fr.CTA Beschreibung Checkliste: This checklist gives you an overview of important insurance policies that are recommended for freelancers. Every business is unique, so it's advisable to discuss your individual insurance needs with an insurance adviser. That way, you can protect yourself comprehensively and run your business successfully.

welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Name: Which insurance do I need as a teacher?
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Headline: Discover the insurance policies that meet the unique needs of a teacher.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Einleitungstext: As a teacher, you bear a great deal of responsibility for your pupils and for the teaching process. Alongside your professional work, it's important to protect yourself personally as well, so that possible risks are covered. Here is a checklist of the recommended insurance policies for teachers:
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Beschreibung Versicherung 1: Official liability insurance protects you against the financial consequences of liability claims that could arise in the course of your professional work as a teacher.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Beschreibung Versicherung 2: Legal expenses insurance provides support in legal disputes, whether in your professional or private life, e.g. in disputes with parents or authorities.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Beschreibung Versicherung 3: Health insurance is essential to ensure comprehensive medical care if you fall ill.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Beschreibung Versicherung 4: Occupational disability insurance provides financial protection if you are permanently unable to work as a teacher due to illness or an accident.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Beschreibung Versicherung 5: Private liability insurance protects you against the financial consequences if you accidentally cause damage to third parties in your private life.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Beschreibung Versicherung 6: Accident insurance provides financial protection in the event of accidents, whether at school or in your free time.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Beschreibung Versicherung 7: Household contents insurance protects your personal belongings and furniture at home against damage caused by burglary, fire or water damage.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Beschreibung Versicherung 8: If you do voluntary work in clubs or other organisations, liability insurance for volunteers is advisable to protect you against liability claims.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Beschreibung Versicherung 9: Plan ahead early for your financial future and make private retirement provision so that you're well covered in retirement.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.Beschreibung Versicherung 10: A private accident pension gives you additional protection in case an accident leaves you permanently impaired and you can therefore no longer carry out your professional work to the full extent.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-le.CTA Beschreibung Checkliste: This checklist gives you an overview of important insurance policies that are recommended for teachers. Every teacher has individual needs, so it's advisable to discuss your personal insurance needs with an insurance adviser. That way, you can comprehensively protect yourself and your future and carry out your professional work with peace of mind.

welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Name: Which insurance do I need as a police officer?
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Headline: Specialist cover for police officers: we show you which insurance policies suit your profession.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Einleitungstext: As a police officer, you're exposed to various risks every day, whether on duty or in your free time. That's why it's important to protect yourself accordingly so that you're well covered if the worst happens. Here is a checklist of the recommended insurance policies for police officers:
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Beschreibung Versicherung 1: Service incapacity insurance is particularly important for police officers, as the job often involves increased risks. It protects you financially if you can no longer work because you've been declared unfit for service.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Beschreibung Versicherung 2: Occupational disability insurance steps in if you're permanently unable to work in your profession as a police officer due to illness or an accident. It ensures that you remain financially protected even in such a case.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Beschreibung Versicherung 3: Private liability insurance is important protection for damage you accidentally cause to third parties, whether in your free time or in the context of your duties.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Beschreibung Versicherung 4: Accident insurance gives you financial protection in the event of accidents, both on duty and in your free time. It can include, for example, disability benefits and a daily hospital allowance.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Beschreibung Versicherung 5: Check whether your employer (Dienstherr) provides official liability insurance for you. It protects you against compensation claims while carrying out your official duties.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Beschreibung Versicherung 6: Legal expenses insurance covers the costs of legal disputes and provides you with legal support to represent your interests.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Beschreibung Versicherung 7: As a police officer, you are usually covered by statutory health insurance. However, also look into supplementary insurance that offers, for example, better benefits in hospital or for alternative treatments.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Beschreibung Versicherung 8: Plan ahead early for your financial future and take out a private pension insurance policy or another form of retirement provision so that you're well covered in retirement.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Beschreibung Versicherung 9: Make sure your belongings at home are adequately insured. Household contents insurance protects your movable possessions, while buildings insurance protects your own house or flat.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.Beschreibung Versicherung 10: If you like to travel, travel insurance is recommended. It includes, for example, trip cancellation insurance, international health insurance and baggage insurance.
welche-versicherungen-brauche-ich-als-po.CTA Beschreibung Checkliste: What matters is that you carefully check your individual insurance needs and get advice from an insurance expert. That way, you can make sure you're optimally covered and can concentrate on your work as a police officer.
